verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CoreWeave lets you create clusters through the Console, Terraform, or the API, and each CKS cluster runs in its own private VPC. A user could build a separate test cluster that way, but that is a user-side arrangement assembled from developer building blocks, not a sandbox or test-environment feature. Nothing in the pack documents a sandbox mode, test environment, or mechanism that isolates testing from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
